A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same FLARE study. Their main text, equations, figures, tables and complete appendices are readable and support comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original results across nine datasets and four models, alongside plan-only ablations and analyses of faithfulness, search behavior and model scale.

after.justification: v3 retains those original results and adds FLARE evaluations on three logic-reasoning benchmarks in Table 2.

M1.justification: The plan, Prolog-code generation, simulated search and final-answer pipeline is retained. Expanded conditioning notation and Appendix A.3 pseudocode document the existing procedure; the supplied prompt instructions do not establish an algorithm change.

E1.justification: v3 adds evaluations on PrOntoQA, LogicalDeduction and AR-LSAT, extending the original nine-dataset coverage to additional deductive and analytical reasoning tasks. Table 2 reports these evaluations using GPT-3.5.

E2.justification: New Table 2 compares FLARE with Standard direct prompting, CoT and Logic-LM. Direct prompting and Logic-LM expand the evaluated comparator set, including another relevant symbolic-solver approach. The original nine-dataset CoT/F-CoT comparison remains unchanged.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 specifies harder subsets following Pan et al. for the added logic evaluations. The original datasets' shot counts and test sizes remain unchanged. Exact sample sizes and shot counts for the new evaluations are not supplied in Appendix Table 9.

E4.justification: Appendix Table 8 adds a worked qualitative case about storing Reiki in a bottle, displaying its plan, code, simulated search failures and final answer. Existing plan-only ablations and faithfulness, search-behavior and scaling analyses are retained unchanged.

E5.justification: The existing boxplots and error bars in Figures 2–4 are retained. Neither version supplies repeated-run or seed counts or significance-testing procedures, and new Table 2 reports point estimates without additional uncertainty information.

E6.justification: New Table 2 reports FLARE accuracies of 73.40, 58.60 and 27.39 on PrOntoQA, LogicalDeduction and AR-LSAT, versus Logic-LM's 61.00, 65.67 and 26.41. These establish two wins and one loss in the added comparison. Original benchmark and analysis tables retain their values; the abstract additionally quantifies previously reported trace differences.

T1.justification: Equations 1–4 make token histories, instructions and answer conditioning more explicit for the pipeline already described in v1, including its final-answer prompt. The consistency definitions and faithfulness calculation are retained, with no new theoretical result, assumption or proof.

C1.justification: The introduction expands the evaluation contribution from nine benchmarks to nine QA plus three logic benchmarks and adds a claim of best performance on two of the three logic tasks. The core contributions concerning simulated search, interpretability and measurable faithfulness remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Both versions retain the same interpretations linking faithfulness, exploration, relation utilization and model scale to performance, including the tradeoff between exact execution and soft reasoning. Rewording clarifies terminology without adding substantive limitations or changing these explanations.

D1.justification: Algorithm 1 and Table 8 add explicit pseudocode and a complete pipeline illustration. Existing GSM8K prompts and greedy-decoding/code-availability disclosures remain. v3 removes the sentence identifying reused in-context examples, while its dataset-statistics table does not document the newly added benchmarks.

R1.justification: v3 adds Logic-LM and sources for PrOntoQA and AR-LSAT. It also replaces the Xu et al. symbolic-chain-of-thought reference used for F-CoT with Lyu et al.'s Faithful Chain-of-Thought paper. These are targeted attribution and positioning changes; most related-work discussion is retained.

P1.justification: Related Work moves from Section 5 to Section 2, and method/results headings are revised. The introduction and Prolog explanation receive localized rewrites, and the appendix gains procedural explanation. Most results discussion and the conclusion remain unchanged; acknowledgments are removed and the header becomes 'Preprint'.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is redrawn with clearer module connections and an expanded overlap explanation. v3 adds the logic-comparison table, worked-example table and algorithm display. Existing plots and tables are retained with some relocation, renumbering and caption adjustments.

improvement.justification: Compared with v1, v3 adds a relevant Logic-LM comparison on additional reasoning tasks and makes the existing pipeline easier to inspect through pseudocode and a worked example. These gains are limited by missing new-dataset statistics in Table 9 and an unexplained aggregation behind Section 5.1's claimed 7% improvement over Logic-LM, which is not readily reconciled with Table 2.
